headline: Lightning mid team
title: Best Lightning Team | Fenmane Blazen Luminelle Besauce | Aniimo Guide
video_script: A great mid game squad is the Lightning team of Fenmane, Blazen, Luminelle and Besauce. Blazen breaks the enemy, Luminelle triggers her team buff, and Fenmane deals the damage. Besauce keeps the energy flowing, and its Electric Dance Frenzy cuts the target's Lightning resistance by seventeen percent. It has no healer, so swap in Glacy against hard bosses. Would you run it? Comment below!

scenes.sub: Energy and minus seventeen percent resistance
